home.title: ChimeraFlow

locale.label: Language
status.heading: API status
sources.excel.description: Supplier price lists in an imperfect format
seam.label: Sources stitched together
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lead: Four sources, one thread: how each one is doing, and what they have in common.
dashboard.degraded.body.one: {sources} is unavailable or degraded. Rules that read it will produce nothing until it responds; the others keep running.
dashboard.degraded.body.other: {sources} are unavailable or degraded. Rules that read them will produce nothing until they respond; the others keep running.
dashboard.run.title: Run the rules
dashboard.run.hint: Reads the four sources and recomputes the correlations of the active rules.
demo.title: Demo
demo.hint: Deletes the correlations and the executions, and puts the predefined rules back in their original state. The rules you created are kept.
demo.confirm.title: Reset the demo
demo.confirm.question: Delete every correlation and put the predefined rules back in their original state?
demo.done: Demo reset. Correlations deleted: {correlations}. Executions deleted: {executions}.
demo.unavailable: This server does not have a demo reset yet.
rules.title: Rules
rules.lead: What ChimeraFlow watches for, written in plain words. Each rule is declarative JSON: nothing is run as code.
rules.detail.title: Rule {id}
rules.delete.title: Delete the rule
rules.delete.question: Delete rule {id} and its correlations?
rules.delete.hint: A predefined rule comes back the next time the server starts.
rule.json.label: Rule JSON
rule.summary.join.sheet: Joins with {source}, sheet "{name}", on the field "{field}".
rule.summary.join.table: Joins with {source}, table "{name}", on the field "{field}".
rule.summary.condition.gap: provided that the relative gap between {field} and {ref} is {op} {tolerance} %
composer.title: New rule
composer.lead: Describe the rule in your own words. You review the draft before saving it.
composer.text.label: Your rule in one sentence
composer.text.placeholder: When a customer asks for cement on WhatsApp, show me the Access stock and warn me if fewer than 10 are left.
composer.language.label: Language of the sentence
composer.suggestions.title: Predefined rules
composer.suggestions.hint.one: Conversion is not available. Start from this predefined rule.

composer.draft.title: Rule draft
composer.draft.review: Review the draft: nothing is saved until you confirm.
correlations.title: Correlations
correlations.lead: What lines up between your files and your conversations, with the evidence for each link.
correlations.empty: No correlation yet. Run the rules from the dashboard.
explanation.title: Why it matches
explanation.trigger: The trigger mentions "{raw}", reduced to the key "{norm}".
explanation.match.token: The words of the shorter name are found in the other one (score {score}).
provenance.title: Provenance
sandbox.title: Normalization sandbox
sandbox.lead: Type product names the way they are really written, and see how ChimeraFlow reduces them to one key.
sandbox.text.label: One name per line
sandbox.text.hint: The first line is the reference text. The following ones (up to {max}) are compared with it.
sandbox.unavailable.title: Sandbox unavailable
sandbox.unavailable.body: The server does not expose the normalization analysis yet. It will be available with the next API version.
sandbox.results.noComparison: Add lines to compare them with the reference text.
